::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 27th [1887]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Westcountry Studies Library, Exeter/  1887/ 1[^1]
:::

My dear [Miss Smith](people/person_263.qmd)

I am much entertained by your Scarborough paper as I remember those Rivaulx terraces some 25 years ago, the only place where my sights coincide with yours.[^2]  I only wish I saw more present prospect of room for it!  You must be one of my oldest contributors.  Did you not like Miss Sewell’s paper on [family traditions](other_books/otherbook_1028.qmd)

yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: MS Westcountry Studies Library, Exeter/  1887/ 2 is a Silurian envelope addressed to Miss Carter Smith/ Aspley House/ Aspley Guise/ Woburn, postmarked Winchester  (date and month cut out) 1887.
[^2]: The article has not been identified.
